meta.name: block-no-verify-hook
meta.description: Configure a PreToolUse hook to prevent AI agents from skipping git pre-commit hooks with --no-verify and other bypass flags. Use when setting up Claude Code projects that enforce commit quality gates.

copy.tagline: 禁止 AI 代理绕过 Git 提交检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude Code 项目中强制提交质量检查。
copy.tagline_en: Block AI agents from skipping pre-commit checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enforce commit quality gates in Claude Code projects.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 运行 git 命令时会先被检查;若命令含 --no-verify 或 --no-gpg-sign,Claude 会拒绝执行并提示不允许,pre-commit 等检查不会被跳过。
howto.when: 当 Claude 准备运行的 git 命令带有 --no-verify 或 --no-gpg-sign 时,会被拦截;只作用于 Bash 工具调用。

say.text: 请正常提交代码,不要跳过 pre-commit 检查。
say.note: 若 Claude 试图加 --no-verify 会被拦下。
这条命令会被拦截并提示。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude's git commands are inspected before execution. If a command contains --no-verify or --no-gpg-sign, Claude rejects it with a notice, so pre-commit checks are not skipped.
howto.when_en: When Claude is about to run a git command that includes --no-verify or --no-gpg-sign through the Bash tool, the hook blocks it.

say_en.text: Please commit normally and do not skip pre-commit checks.
say_en.note: If Claude tries --no-verify, it will be blocked.
This flag will be rejected too.
